description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

schedule.note: Routine fires at 06:00 GMT. Signals are only valid if posted between 02:30 and 08:30 GMT, before the US market opens at 14:30 GMT.

confluence.note: With-trend setups need 4/6; counter-trend (weekly bear vs daily bull) need 5/6.

risk.note: Stop = entry − (atr_stop_multiplier × ATR14). Target = entry + (atr_target_multiplier × ATR14). R:R must be ≥ min_rr or signal is downgraded to WAIT.

macro_kill_switches.note: VIX > vix_max → stop all signals. VIX > vix_high_confidence_only_above → require 5+/6. VIX > vix_caution_above → add position-sizing caution note.

momentum.note: Momentum confirms BUY when RSI is in [rsi_buy_low, rsi_buy_high] AND MACD bullish.

volume.note: Relative to 20-day average. Below neutral_threshold = WEAK = automatic non-confirm.

earnings.note: post_earnings_raised_bar: first day back after blackout requires 5/6 confluence (not 4/6).

volatility.note: BB width < bb_squeeze_threshold × 30d avg = SQUEEZE. > bb_extreme_threshold × 30d avg AND ATR > atr_extreme_threshold × 90d avg = EXTREME → WAIT.

sentiment.note: News sentiment score from Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT. Must be ≥ min_score_for_confirm and no flagged keywords to confirm Sentiment category.
